text: Alatau City Bank (formerly Jusan Bank) is controlled by Kazakh businessman Vyacheslav Kim: he completed the purchase of the bank by taking control of its parent First Heartland Securities in July 2025, and press describe him as the bank's sole shareholder.
short: Alatau City Bank is controlled by businessman Vyacheslav Kim, named by press as its sole shareholder.

source.name: Kursiv.kz — Владелец Alatau City Bank сменит название
source.quote: И только в июле 2025-го Ким завершил покупку бывшего Jusan Bank, получив контроль над FHS.
source.note: Translation: 'It was only in July 2025 that Kim completed the purchase of the former Jusan Bank, gaining control of FHS (First Heartland Securities, the bank's owner company).'

additionalSources.name: Exclusive.kz — Миллиардер, совладелец крупного банка создал холдинговую компанию в МФЦА
additionalSources.quote: совладелец Kaspi.kz и единственный акционер Alatau City Bank Вячеслав Ким зарегистрировал в Международном финансовом центре «Астана» новую холдинговую компанию
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Kaspi.kz co-owner and sole shareholder of Alatau City Bank Vyacheslav Kim registered a new holding company in the Astana International Financial Centre.'
